title: Creeperlings
description: Replaces creepers griefing blocks with them spawning creeperlings instead
body:
Replaces creepers griefing blocks with them spawning creeperlings when exploding.

Creeperlings are smaller versions of creepers, that deal less damage, have less health, and are faster.

Creepers also apply a new effect called "spored" to surrounding entities and creeperlings when exploding, which make it so entities have a chance to spawn more creeperlings when taking damage.
